original.question: Area ya kamore ya go robala ya Billie e e rectangular ke 360 maoto a sekwere. Fa botelele jwa kamore bo le 3 leya(s), perimeter ya kamore ke eng ka maoto?
original.answer:
Botelele jwa kamore ke 3 leya(s) * (3 maoto / 1 leya(s)) = <<3*(3/1)=9>>9 maoto.
Bophara jwa kamore ke 360 maoto a sekwere / 9 maoto = <<360/9=40>>40 maoto.
Perimeter ya kamore ke 2(40+9) = 98 maoto
